memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Hypothyroidism, newly diagnosed.
Patient reports fatigue, weight gain, and cold intolerance over the past 2 months. Examination shows mild dry skin, delayed relaxation of deep tendon reflexes, and a non-tender thyroid. Smoking status: never smoked; pack-years 0. No inhaler prescribed; technique not applicable. TSH 8.2 mIU/L (ref 0.4-4.0), free T4 0.8 ng/dL (ref 0.9-1.7).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Hypothyroidism, on levothyroxine 50 mcg OD.
Patient notes improved energy but still experiences occasional fatigue and mild weight gain. Examination: skin less dry, reflexes normalizing. Smoking status: never smoked; pack-years 0. No inhaler prescribed; technique not applicable. TSH 5.6 mIU/L (ref 0.4-4.0), free T4 1.0 ng/dL (ref 0.9-1.7).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been feeling more tired lately and have gained a few kilograms despite watching my diet.

Hypothyroidism, on levothyroxine 100 mcg OD.
Patient denies fatigue, reports feeling well and weight stable. Examination: normal skin texture, reflexes brisk. Smoking status: never smoked; pack-years 0. No inhaler prescribed; technique not applicable. TSH 2.5 mIU/L (ref 0.4-4.0), free T4 1.3 ng/dL (ref 0.9-1.7).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Hypothyroidism, on levothyroxine 100 mcg OD.
Patient continues to feel well, no symptoms of hypo- or hyperthyroidism. Examination: normal. Smoking status: never smoked; pack-years 0. No inhaler prescribed; technique not applicable. TSH 2.2 mIU/L (ref 0.4-4.0), free T4 1.4 ng/dL (ref 0.9-1.7).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Hypothyroidism, stable on levothyroxine 100 mcg OD.
Patient remains asymptomatic, maintains normal weight, and reports good energy levels. Examination: unremarkable. Smoking status: never smoked; pack-years 0. No inhaler prescribed; technique not applicable. TSH 2.0 mIU/L (ref 0.4-4.0), free T4 1.5 ng/dL (ref 0.9-1.7).
